description: Escapify brings exciting new updates, SponsorBlock integration, smooth 120Hz lyrics, and custom enhancements.

changelog.title: What's New in Escapify
items: Integrated SponsorBlock: automatically skip sponsor ads, dialogues, and non-music sections in music videos
Added SponsorBlock customization settings under Player & Audio with category toggles and skip toasts
Fixed Lyrics v2 rendering: smooth synchronized scrolling without text clipping or stutter
Enhanced Search Suggestions: accurate track and artist playback matching

changelog.title: Fixes & Improvements
items: Restored direct in-app updater and 1-tap APK install
Overhauled download engine with 1-tap ghost track cleanup and storage integrity repairs
High-contrast enlarged app launcher icon and official release banner
